target.title: fix(hooks): avoid implicit hook delivery targets
target.body:
## Summary
- Stop `/hooks/agent` from constructing isolated cron announce delivery with implicit `channel=last` and no `to`.
- Keep explicit hook delivery working when callers provide both `channel` and `to`.
- Document the explicit target requirement and add focused hook/cron delivery tests.

## Bug / Behavior
KAN-192 tracks recurring Herbert/Symphony hook final-delivery failures. Hook agent requests accepted the webhook POST but then ran as isolated cron-like jobs whose fallback delivery attempted to resolve the shared agent main session's last chat recipient. Current runtime correctly refuses that implicit delivery because it can target the wrong conversation after restart or cross-conversation reuse.

## Evidence
- `src/gateway/server/hooks.ts` defaulted `deliver !== false` into `delivery.mode="announce"` with `channel=value.channel` where omitted channel normalizes to `last` and no `to`.
- `src/cron/delivery-plan.ts` and `src/cron/isolated-agent/run.ts` then ask isolated cron delivery resolution for `channel="last"`.
- `src/cron/isolated-agent/delivery-target.ts` resolves `last` from session state, which is the unsafe path for non-chat hook sessions.

## Tests
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/gateway/server/hooks.ts src/gateway/server.hooks.test.ts src/cron/isolated-agent/delivery-target.test.ts docs/automation/cron-jobs.md` ✅
- `pnpm test src/gateway/server.hooks.test.ts src/cron/isolated-agent/delivery-target.test.ts` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `pnpm changed:lanes --json` selected core/coreTests/docs.
- `pnpm check:changed` partial: early guards and `tsgo:core` passed; `tsgo:core:test` was terminated after ~18m of no output/slow progress in local fallback because Blacksmith Testbox was not authenticated.
- `pnpm test:changed` did not complete: broad gateway shard retried and timed out after no output; focused touched tests above passed.

## GitNexus
- `/home/coolmann/.local/bin/gitnexus-openai status` reported current commit/base indexed and up to date before changes.
- `/home/coolmann/.local/bin/gitnexus-openai analyze --embeddings --skip-agents-md` after changes: `Already up to date`.

## Notes
No gateway config, credentials, secrets, allowlists, runtime SQLite, or service restarts were changed.
